publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.18 brings back the owner setup design. First-run setup asks for your name, sign-in email and installation name, with an optional website. Owners can rename the installation in Settings > General, and the name appears across the app. In Settings > People, edit your own name and email, with guidance if your current sign-in email needs confirmation or an address is already in use. Settings > Alerts explains when no destination matches your sign-in address and refreshes after destination edits. The deployment dry-run summary lists the Worker, D1 database and migration count, Cron triggers, and secret binding names. Use rer deploy --dry-run --json for the full plan. The dry run makes no provider requests. The monitor-definition guide lists all 13 supported types, including mail, API transactions, browser journeys, and page speed. Hono is updated to 4.13.16, and picomatch includes a patch for excessive backtracking in single-branch extglobs. The exact @runeditrun/rer 0.2.121 pin carries forward from 0.5.17. There are 91 SQL migration files before and after. Every 0.5.17 migration is byte-identical, and zero migrations or required settings were added. Monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained on upgrade. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For local CLI backup, stop dev and run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer with the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE described in the backup guide. Keep it private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. Keep the deployment receipt and use the existing installation keys for this upgrade. The mail enable/disable commands and legacy SendGrid selector guidance under 0.5.16 still apply. Earlier upgrade cautions still apply, including older heartbeat output, UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, restoration of the erased-people list, empty company decision feeds, the 64 KiB response-body limit, and large-scale archive operation that has yet to be established. Pingdom TMS scripts and recordings, Page Speed, relationships and history remain unconverted. Live account cutover and managed geographic equivalence have yet to be established. Imported definitions stay paused and credentials need local re-entry. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png, captured on 0.4.0. It predates the owner setup and Settings changes in this release. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-19.
